tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅: rta mgrin dregs pa kun sgrol gyi lhag ma dang bro rabs bzhugs so:

de nas lhag ma byin gyis brlab pa ni: ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐: zhes brjod pas phud gzhong nyi ma'i da lar gyur pa las: gtor ma byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin: hūm̐ gi tshogs 'phro bar bsam: paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐: zhes brjod pas lhag ma'i gzhong pa pad+ma 'dab brgyad du gyur pa la zhal zas ni byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin: hrīḥ'abar ba 'phro zhing 'du bar bsam: de nas skul tshig 'di skad gyer ro: hūm̐: byang chub sems kyi sprin tshogs las: 'byung ba chu bo'i rgyun 'byung ba'i: mkha' 'gro pad+ma'i gzhal yas su: bde ba thugs kyi dkyil 'khor spros: mkhar 'gro'i 'khor tshogs thams cad la: dgyes mnyes mchog gi sbyin pas tshim: zhes brjod la kha chu gdab bo: dz+nyā na hūm̐: zhes brjod pas: hūm̐ dang hrīḥganyis 'dres pa las 'dod yon du bsgyur nas phud dang lhag ma bsre'o: 'dod yon de las so so ci la dga' ba'i mchod sbyin du gyur par bsam nas: yang 'di skad brjod par bya'o: hūm̐: phud dang gtsang ma mi sbrags rgyu: gar gyi dbang phyug phud kyi bdag: de phyir phud dang gtsang mar sbrags: lhag ma kha chus mi gdab rgyu: khyed dang 'o skol dam tshig gcig: bka' yi pha 'bab mi bstsal rgyu: dbang phyug ma ni bran gyi tshul: hūm̐: dbang chen pad+ma gser gyi gdan khri la: gser gyi seng ge 'degs pa'i rngam tshul can: kha rlangs hrīḥyi 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro: rtsal gyi rngam gyis 'khor ba'i 'bros khungs gcod: stobs kyi rlabs kyis rgyal ba'i pho brang 'degs: skad kyi gcom gyis gsang ba'i thugs dam bskul: gser gyi 'od kyis ma rig mun pa sel: he ru ma bdun phra men tshogs dang bcas: phyag brnyan gtum chen khyung gi khra thabs thogs: bskal pa me ri khyab pa'i rtse 'joms shing: keng ro gsar rnying bcad 'dral khra la la: tshar gsum lcang lo rak+ta'i rba klong 'khyil: rngams pa'i zhal nas 'brug sgra gsung sgrog pas:

bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma dam can rnams: rnam dag yum gyi mkha' las bzhengs nas su: bdud rtsi sman gyi phyag rgyas g.yab 'dor na: glu dang spyugs pa'i brda yis mtshon nas kyang: ma tshogs nang gi dam la btags so 'tshal: bka' dang dam tshig bzhin du gshegs su gsol: gsang sngags he ru ka dpal bka' bsgos pa'i: dbang phyug ma dang brtan ma ging gi tshogs: lhag ma'i mchod sbyin bzhes par dam bcas rnams: dam tshig tshul bzhin mchod kyis gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: thabs chen zla gsang thig le las: yal gam can la rab dgongs pa'i: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro mched: stong gsum ma lus dag byed pa'i: bdag nyid chen mo gshegs su gsol: byang gi 'brog chen 'khor 'dul ma: glog phreng 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: 'jigs byed rngams pa'i tshul ston cing: pho nya 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ sbreng ba dang: spyugs pa blang zhing g.yab 'dor na: phra men mkha' 'gro ma lus kun: sprin phung bzhin du gshegs su gsol: mched la gdung ste gshegs su gsol: dam la gnas te gshegs su gsol: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: dam tshig dus la bab bo sa ma ya: bh+yo ma ma ma hā rak+sha sī sa ma ya dza dza: zhes dbang phyug ma'i snying po bsgrang: de nas gtor bskyang ni: bh+yo: shar phyogs rig pa'i rgyal mo bdun: srin mo g.yag dang tshangs pa sbrul: khro mo gzig dang khyab 'jug sre: gzhon nu pha wang dbang mo dred: nag mo khu byug ral pa can: rdo rje rigs kyi dbang phyug ma: dam tshig tshul bzhin mchod par 'bul: thugs dam bzhin du bzhes su gsol: bh+yo: lho yi phyogs nas blon mo bdun: dmar mo dbang mo bdud rtsi chu: zla ba sdig pa be con khra: srin mo wa dang za ba'i khyi: ser mo ra dang zhags 'dren ma: rin chen rigs kyi dbang phyug ma: dam tshig tshul bzhin mchod par 'bul: thugs dam bzhin du bzhes su gsol: bh+yo: nub kyi phyogs nas dbang mo bdun:

dga' mo 'dod dang khrag 'thung rta: gcig spyod byi la mdangs spel dang: grub pa'i pu shud rlung mo spra: bum rna seng mgo lcags sgrog ma: pad+ma rigs kyi dbang phyug ma: dam tshig tshul bzhin mchod par 'bul: thugs dam bzhin du bzhes su gsol: bh+yo: byang gi phyogs na g.yog mo bdun: gsod byed skyin dang 'dod pa mo: nag mo phag dang gshin rje glang: sna tshogs glang dang rlung mo chu: nag mo dred mgo dril 'khrol dgyes: las kyi rigs kyi dbang phyug ma: dam tshig tshul bzhin mchod par 'bul: thugs dam bzhin du bzhes su gsol: ces lhag ma bskyang ngo: de nas bshal chus brtan ma bskyang ba ni: bh+yo: brtan ma skyong ma ma dang sring: dpal ldan ma dang yang dag shes: khyung btsun kong lha g.yu bun ma: me tog zla 'od byang rgyal ma: gser thang kun bzang shān ting dpal: klu mo gzi 'bar la sogs te: brtan ma bcu gnyis bshal chu bzhes: mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen rnams zlog: chos dang mthun pa'i don rnams sgrubs: bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: de nas chad mdo ni las gtor la bya'o: bh+yo: sngon gyi 'das dus bskal pa dang po la: 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang du: dpal chen pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug des: srid pa ma mo dam la btags pa'i tshe: ke rī la sogs gnas kyi ma mo brgyad: siṃ ha la sogs yul gyi phra men brgyad: rta gdong la sogs sgo ma bzhi rnams kyis: so so'i gzugs bstan dam la btags nas kyang: bka' yi gtor ma blang bar ma chad dam: rnal 'byor sku tshe bsring bar ma chad dam: bcol ba'i las rnams bya bar ma chad dam: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam la ma 'da' bar: ba ling rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sgrub mchog bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: dus bskal 'das pa de yi 'og tsam na: rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi dben gnas su: slob dpon chen po dga' rab rdo rje yis: rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe:

mkha' 'gro chen mo sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis: so so'i gzugs bstan dam la btags nas kyang: bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam: rnal 'byor sku tshe= bcol ba'i las rnams= sngon tshe zhal bzhes= ba ling rgyan gyi= sgrub mchog bcol pa'i= dus dang bskal pa de yi 'og rol du: slob dpon chen po nam mkha'i snying po yis: lho brag mkhar chu gnyan gyi dben gnas su: rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas: gnam lcags phur pa brag la btab pa'i tshe: ma bdun sring bzhi 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis: so so'i gzugs bstan= bka' yi gtor ma= rnal 'byor sku tshe= bcol ba'i las rnams= sngon tshe zhal bzhes= ba ling rgyan gyi= sgrub mchog bcol pa'i= dus skabs 'das pa de yi 'og rol du: spa gro stag tshang seng ge'i yang phug tu: slob dpon chen po rlangs chen dpal seng gis: yang dag grub pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: dbang phyug chen mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyis: so so'i gzugs bstan dam la btags nas kyang: bka' yi gtor ma blang bar ma chad dam: rnal 'byor sku tshe bsring bar ma chad dam: bcol ba'i las rnams bya bar ma chad dam: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam la ma 'da' bar: ba ling rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sgrub mchog bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: dus skabs 'das pa de yi 'og tsam du: slob dpon gnyags kyi dz+nyā na ku mā ras: yar mo lung gi gad pa'i phug ring du: phun sum tshogs pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: dam sri rnam gsum rdul du brlag pa'i dus: lce spyang nag mo 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis: so so'i gzugs bstan= bka' yi gtor ma= rnal 'byor sku tshe= bcol ba'i las rnams= sngon tshe zhal bzhes= ba liṃ rgyan gyi= rnal 'byor bcol pa'i= dus skabs 'das pa de yi phyi rol du: slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: brag dmar bsam yas ar+ya pa gling du: man ngag lta ba'i phreng ba bshad pa'i tshe:

bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis kyis: so so'i gzugs bstan= bka' yi gtor ma= bcol ba'i las rnams= sngon tshe zhal bzhes= do nub rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol pa'i las rnams 'grub par mdzod: bdag cag rig 'dzin sngags 'chang gi: lo kag zla kag bzlog tu gsol: 'khor srungs rkyen zlog bar chad sol: tshe srings nor spel bsam pa sgrubs: las dang 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: ces chad mdo bya'o: de nas bro dang tshas kyis dgra bgegs mnan pa ni: hūm̐: nub phyogs snang ba mtha' yas zhing khams na: dbang gi zla gam gdengs pa'i gzhal yas su: gzi ldan 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po ru: gdug pa'i klu brgyad brtsegs pa'i khri steng nas: las la mnga' mdzad pad+ma he ru ka: khrag 'thung khro bo rab 'byams dbyings nas bzhengs: hūm̐: 'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis mchod pa 'bul: dgyes pa'i tshul gyis mchod par bzhes: che mchog badz+ra he ru ka: phyi mchod rdo rje'i glu drug bro: glu yang drug la bro yang drug: glu drug gsang ba'i dbyings dang sbyor: bro drug 'dul ba'i las dang sbyor: glu drug dbyangs su blang ba ni: tshangs pa'i glus ni zhing khams sbyong: dpal gyi glus ni 'phro 'du gsal: khro bo'i glus ni bdud bzhi 'dul: gdung ba'i glus ni ma sring bsten: hūm̐ sgra'i glus ni 'phro 'du 'khrugs: dbu ma'i glus ni dgongs rgyud gsal: 'di yan glu drug go: dbang gi glus ni srin po 'dul: las kyi glus ni pho nya 'gyed: glu drug rdzogs par ldan par bshad: bro drug rdzogs par ldan par brdung: khro bo'i bro brdung dregs pa 'joms: dpal gyi bro brdung bdud bzhi 'dul: ma sring bro brdung gdug pa 'dul: dbang gi bro brdung srin po 'dul: las kyi bro brdung pho nyar 'gyed: rnal 'byor bro brdung thugs dam bskul: 'di ni dpal gyi thugs dam yin: 'di ni yum gyi gsang tshig yin:

'di ni ma sring dngos grub yin: 'di ni pho nya'i longs spyod yin: 'di ni rnal 'byor lta ba'i bro: dgra ni thal bar brlag pa'i bro: bdud ni phye mar gtong ba'i bro: rgyud drug gnas su sbyong ba'i bro: 'gro drug g.yang sa gcod pa'i bro: 'jigs pa'i bdud bzhi 'dul ba'i bro: gsang ba'i dgra gsum gsod pa'i bro: ting 'dzin dgongs rgyud dag pas brdung: da ni mar la dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa'i bro brdung ba ni: hūm̐: 'jig rten drug gi yul drug nas: 'khor yug dur khrod chen po na: ma traṃ ru dra bsgral ba'i tshe: nga ni ya mān+ta ka yin: che ba zil gyis gnon pa'i tshe: nga ni che mchog he ru ka: dus gsum sangs rgyas brgyud pa'i tshe: nga ni rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas yin: khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i phyir: nga ni rta mgrin rgyal po yin: chos sku 'gyur ba med pa'i phyir: nga ni rdo rje gzhon nu yin: dgra bgegs rdul du brlag pa'i phyir: nga ni phyag na rdo rje yin: hūm̐: stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na: shar phyogs stong gi 'jig rten na: zhe sdang rdo rje 'khor bcas kyis: rdo rje'i rigs kyi bro brdungs pas: dgra ni thal bar brlag pa'i bro: bdud ni phye mar btang ba'i bro: dngul lam dkar po'i shing dag la: mgo bo rgya mdud rtse zlum po: logs la zhi ba'i lha bsgoms nas: btab na thams cad zhi bar mdzad: zhi mdzad lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: bdag cag dge sde grwa tshan gyi: dgra bgegs 'byung po zhi bar mdzod: zhi bar gyur cig shān+ting ku ru ye swā hā: hūm̐: stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na: lho phyogs stong gi 'jig rten na: nga rgyal rin chen 'khor bcas kyis: rin chen rigs kyi bro brdungs pas: dgra ni thal bar brlag pa'i bro: bdud ni phye mar btang ba'i bro: gser ram ser po'i shing dag la: mgo bo rgya mdud rtse gru bzhi: logs la rgyas pa'i lha bsgoms nas:

btab na thams cad rgyas par mdzad: rgyas mdzad lha la phyag 'tshal lo: bdag cag dge sde grwa tshan gyi: tshe dang longs spyod rgyas par mdzod: rgyas par gyur cig puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: hūm̐: stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na: nub phyogs stong gi 'jig rten na: 'dod chags pad+ma 'khor bcas kyis: pad+ma rigs kyi bro brdungs pas: dgra ni thal bar brlag pa'i bro: bdud ni phye mar btang ba'i bro: zangs sam dmar po'i shing dag la: mgo bo rgya mdud rtse zla gam: logs la dbang gi lha bsgoms nas: btab na thams cad dbang du mdzad: dbang mdzad lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: bdag cag dge sde grwa tshan gyi: dgra bgegs 'byung po dbang du sdus: dbang du sdus shig pa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: hūm̐: stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na: byang phyogs stong gi 'jig rten na: phrag dog phrin las 'khor bcas kyis: las kyi rigs kyi bro brdungs pas: dgra ni thal bar brlag pa'i bro: bdud ni phye mar btang ba'i bro: lcags sam drag po'i shing dag la: mgo bo rgya mdud rtse zur gsum: logs la drag po'i lha bsgoms nas: btab na thams cad brlag par mdzad: bdag cag dge sde grwa tshan gyi: dgra bgegs 'byung po brlag par mdzod: brlag par gyur cig a mu kaṃ mā ra ya phaṭa: phrin las rnam bzhi'i bro rabs rdzogs so: :
